title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Matthew 19: a question about divorce, little children brought to Jesus, the rich young man, and the promise to those who follow.

questions.text: What did the Pharisees ask Jesus in order to test him?
questions.explanation: Pharisees came to him, testing him, and asked whether it is lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason.

answers.text: Whether a man may divorce his wife for any reason
Whether it is lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not
Whether a man may do work on the Sabbath day
Whether the dead will rise in the resurrection

questions.text: In the words Jesus quoted, what does a man do for this cause?
questions.explanation: He answered that for this cause a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh.

answers.text: He builds a house for himself in his own city
He brings a gift to the altar of the temple
He leaves his father and mother and is joined to his wife
He takes a certificate from the elders of the city

questions.text: Why did Jesus say Moses allowed them to divorce their wives?
questions.explanation: He said Moses allowed it because of the hardness of their hearts, but that from the beginning it had not been so.

answers.text: Because the people asked for it
Because of the hardness of their hearts
Because the land was full of strangers
Because the law of the prophets required it

questions.text: What did Jesus say when the disciples rebuked those who brought little children to him?
questions.explanation: Jesus said to allow the little children and not to forbid them to come to him, for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.

answers.text: That the children should first be taught
That he would see them in the morning
That their parents should pray instead
That they should allow the little children to come to him

questions.text: What did Jesus tell the man to do if he wanted to enter into life?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that no one is good but God alone, and that if he wanted to enter into life he should keep the commandments.

answers.text: Fast and pray for many days
Bring an offering to the temple
Keep the commandments
Follow the elders of the people

questions.text: What did Jesus tell him to do if he wanted to be perfect?
questions.explanation: Jesus told him to go, sell what he had and give to the poor, so he would have treasure in heaven, and then to come and follow him.

answers.text: Sell what he had, give to the poor, and follow him
Build a house of prayer in his city
Teach the commandments to others
Go up to Jerusalem with the multitude

questions.text: Why did the young man go away sad?
questions.explanation: When the young man heard the saying he went away sad, because he was one who had great possessions.

answers.text: Because he had broken the commandments
Because he had great possessions
Because the disciples sent him away
Because he had no family left

questions.text: What comparison did Jesus make about a rich man entering God's Kingdom?
questions.explanation: He said it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into God's Kingdom.

answers.text: It is like a sheep crossing a river
It is like a tower built on sand
It is like a lamp carried in the wind
It is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye

questions.text: What did Jesus say those who had followed him would sit on?
questions.explanation: He said that when the Son of Man sits on the throne of his glory, those who had followed him would also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

answers.text: Twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel
Seats of honor at the wedding feast
The best seats in the synagogues
A throne at his right hand and at his left

questions.text: What did Jesus say about many who are first?
questions.explanation: He said that many will be last who are first, and first who are last.

answers.text: The greatest will be called teachers
Many who are first will be last, and the last first
Those who followed will be called brothers
Everyone will receive the same reward
